properties.name: json-csv-bridge.delimiter
properties.description: Field delimiter used between CSV columns.

properties.name: json-csv-bridge.encoding
properties.description: Charset used when reading and writing CSV files and streams.

properties.name: json-csv-bridge.line-terminator
properties.description: Row terminator. Use \r\n when the file is opened in Excel on Windows.

properties.name: json-csv-bridge.quote-char
properties.description: Character used to quote fields that contain the delimiter, a quote or a line break.

properties.name: json-csv-bridge.null-value
properties.description: Text written for null or missing values. Empty by default.

properties.name: json-csv-bridge.byte-order-mark
properties.description: Whether to write a BOM. Turn this on when Excel garbles non-ASCII text.

properties.name: json-csv-bridge.flatten
properties.description: How nested objects and arrays are spread into columns.

values.description: Keep nested values as a JSON string in a single cell.
Join both object keys and array indices with a dot: addr.city, tags.0.
Join object keys with a dot and array indices with brackets: addr.city, tags[0].
